title: Foreign Institutional Ownership and the Global Convergence of Financial Reporting Practices

scopes.description: Full reproduction workflow for the supplied Internet Appendix, including its definition table and supplemental outputs Tables IA1–IA13 for the referenced paper.

requirements.description: Author-prepared analysis inputs needed to reproduce the supplemental analyses listed as Tables IA1–IA13. The appendix reports results for the 1998–2009 sample and defines some appendix-only variables, but does not supply row-level analysis files, full variable specifications, file schemas, or a compatible acquisition route.

issues.description: The frozen package inventory contains only the Internet Appendix PDF; there is no author README, runnable entry point, data-preparation code, or supporting program.

No author instructions identify stages, entry points, runtime/software, configuration, or execution order for the supplemental analyses. The package contains results and definitions, not an executable workflow, so dependency closure cannot be established.

The appendix reports sample summaries and regression results, but this release supplies no row-level analysis data and no compatible file-level specification, identifiers, field coverage, transformations, or verified local/public/restricted route for those inputs.

The Internet Appendix refers to the main paper’s Appendix A for detailed variable definitions. That documentation is not included in the supplied package, leaving some controls and derived variables unspecified for a future workflow assessment.

actions.description: Request the executable workflow, complete variable documentation, and compatible data specification for the full set of supplied appendix outputs.
steps: Request the author README/run instructions and all scripts and supporting programs used for the main-paper workflow and supplemental Internet Appendix Tables IA1–IA13, with their actual execution order, software/runtime versions, configuration, and manual inputs.
Request the missing main-paper Appendix A variable definitions and any other data dictionary/codebook needed to interpret derived variables and controls referenced by the Internet Appendix.

Request author-prepared analysis datasets or a complete input specification listing each file/product, fields, firm/country/year identifiers, units, construction, and coverage for the 1998–2009 analyses; identify which inputs are already author-prepared and which, if any, require acquisition.

Clarify the documented data sources and permitted routes for any required inputs not supplied by the authors; do not treat mentioned historical source products as usable routes until their product, compatibility, coverage, and access conditions are verified.
validation: After receipt, map the definition table and each supplemental Table IA1–IA13 to actual entry points and required producer stages, then verify complete dependency coverage and execution order.

Confirm that every data route supports the required variables, identifiers, transformations, market/country coverage, and 1998–2009 history before any separately authorized execution; compare the resulting outputs to the appendix tables.
